questions.stem: How do the students check the finished map?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "Before we hang the map up, another class walks around the school to check it. Their small corrections help us make a map that new students can trust." This supports the answer: "Another class walks around the school to compare it.".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：挂地图之前，另一个班绕学校走了一圈来检查。 他们的小修正帮助我们做出新生可以信赖的地图。 因此正确选项为“Another class walks around the school to compare it.”。

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "Our art class is making a large map for the school entrance. I ask Joel to pass the red pen to Sara at the far end of the table. She uses it to mark the main gate beside the road. Then I point to a blank square where the sports hall should be. Joel checks a photograph and draws the missing building in the right place. Before we hang the map up, another class walks around the school to check it. Their small corrections help us make a map that new students can trust." This supports the answer: "Cooperating to make an accurate school map".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：我们美术班正在为学校入口制作一张大地图。 我请乔尔把红笔递给桌子远端的萨拉。 她用它标出路旁的大门。 然后我指向体育馆应该在的那个空白方格。 乔尔查看照片，把遗漏的建筑画在正确位置。 挂地图之前，另一个班绕学校走了一圈来检查。 他们的小修正帮助我们做出新生可以信赖的地图。 因此正确选项为“Cooperating to make an accurate school map”。

questions.stem: Why do the children thank the assistant?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "The assistant opens the screen and shows us its simple controls. We play with the robot on a clear table near the window. We return the robot carefully and thank her for letting us explore it before deciding." This supports the answer: "She lets them try the robot before deciding.".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：店员打开玻璃屏，给我们演示简单的操控方法。 我们在窗边一张空桌上玩这个机器人。 我们小心地交还机器人，感谢她让我们在决定前先探索。 因此正确选项为“She lets them try the robot before deciding.”。

options.label: C
options.text: She lets them try the robot before deciding.

options.label: D
options.text: She teaches them to build a glass screen.

questions.stem: Which title best fits the passage?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "In the toy shop, a small robot stands behind a glass screen. My brother points at it and asks whether he can try it. The assistant opens the screen and shows us its simple controls. We play with the robot on a clear table near the window. It walks between two blocks, stops at the edge and turns back. My brother wants to press every button, but he follows the assistant's instructions. We return the robot carefully and thank her for letting us explore it before deciding." This supports the answer: "Trying a Robot in a Toy Shop".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：玩具店里，一个小机器人站在玻璃屏后面。 弟弟指着它，问能否试试。 店员打开玻璃屏，给我们演示简单的操控方法。 我们在窗边一张空桌上玩这个机器人。 它走过两块积木之间，在桌边停下，再转回来。 弟弟想按每一个按钮，但还是遵照店员的说明。 我们小心地交还机器人，感谢她让我们在决定前先探索。 因此正确选项为“Trying a Robot in a Toy Shop”。

translation.stem: 哪个标题最适合这篇短文？
